interpretation: Single high-field ordered-SMD pathway. Contacts, candidate hydrogen bonds, ion/water bridges, base orientations and passage order are geometric nonequilibrium observables; they are not binding free energies, experimental -120 mV dwell times, or an unbiased translocation rate.
potassium_bridge_definition: one K+ within 3.5 A of a DNA oxygen and an ASP/GLU oxygen
water_bridge_definition: one water oxygen within 3.5 A of DNA polar atoms and constriction polar atoms
